Dr. Darshan Kumar Sharma

Chairman

Our mission is to provide quality education that empowers students to build successful careers in healthcare and the professional sectors.

Chairman’s message

As I am sure everyone is aware, the moment in which we now find ourselves is one of profound challenge—not only for our campus and the wider education system, but for the nation and the world as a whole.

At New Anmol Group of Institutions, we recognize that some challenges can be addressed directly through our collective efforts and commitment. Others may lie beyond our immediate control; however, we believe it is our responsibility to engage with them—through dialogue, collaboration, and thoughtful action—while striving to influence meaningful change.

We believe in combining academic excellence with practical training to develop skilled, confident and responsible professionals. Our focus is not only on education, but also on overall personality development, discipline and ethical values. With dedicated faculty, modern infrastructure and industry-oriented programmes, we strive to create an environment where students can achieve their full potential.

As leadership, we remain dedicated to speaking publicly when needed to uphold our values and working diligently behind the scenes to ensure that the voice of New Anmol Group of Institutions is heard across relevant platforms and communities.

We envision the future of New Anmol Group of Institutions as a strong, unified yet diverse academic community—where every individual is given equal opportunity to teach, to learn and to grow. We are committed to ensuring that education is not limited by financial constraints, unequal access or differences among us.

In this, as in all the responsibilities we undertake together, our focus remains on excellence, inclusivity and continuous progress for the benefit of our students, faculty and society.

I warmly welcome all aspiring students to join us and become a part of this journey towards excellence and success.

Dr. Darshan Kumar Sharma
Chairman
